notes:
**Search finds every word.** Each word you type is now matched on its own, in any order, across the title and composer, so "Bach to" finds Bach's Toccatas.

**Sort by Imported.** A new "Imported" button in the Library's sort row lists the newest imports first. "Recent" still means recently opened.

**Clearing the search puts the keyboard away.**

If you use two tablets together, update both.
